findings.detail: The unchanged main calls AgentdProductionStartup::from_process_environment, identity, receive, and the existing AgentdProductionLaunch::run. The new opt-in is an exhaustive Startup variant selected by --root-production-entry late-writer inside that actual path. It is not an uncalled convenience API. Absence of the selector returns the original argument vector, including non-UTF8 bytes, to the original branches.

The selector rejects duplicate, missing or unknown modes before rights acquisition. OriginalLateWriterInputs::prepare_original_late_writer_inputs uses the existing full input parser and actual dedicated non-Root UID/GID check. The parser retains the existing Primary input, pairing, distinct inherited FD and ownership checks. Owned input rights are captured before the read-only identity discovery opens registry paths. Failure consumes the attempt through existing FD drops; there is no fallback to the ordinary path or reconstructed descriptor.

The new config reader uses the real Supervisor environment, canonical FleetRegistry and exact Starting generation to assemble the complete comparison AgentdIdentity, including resources, layout, home/run/workspace and socket paths. It does not open the writer, create AgentdConfig, mutate Registry, mint an issuer or authorize a lifecycle transition. The original sealed Root bootstrap, peer/process binding and actual Config load independently recheck that comparison after the five-lane connection.

The 3679-byte original body beginning with reception of (bootstrap, root_pidfd, writer), through original five-lane connection, Root0600 writer handoff, actual Starting Config load, optional Learning/Model connection and final original writer checks is byte-for-byte unchanged after factoring into the owned shared consumer. The original require_late_owner and original_session_remaining implementations are also byte-equal. No new File/FD constructor, key, proof, grant or identity substitution is introduced.

The private non-Clone input object stores the original absolute session_end once. The receive path subtracts elapsed time via the unchanged helper rather than restarting the budget after preflight or any Root lane. Owned descriptors, Root session and Config continue to use their existing Drop/cancellation behavior. The new startup object cannot restore a failed or retired session.

The original main source is unchanged. Existing default Ordinary and Root branches retain their original source except for the new exhaustive variant and explicit early selector. The config.rs delta is only a Linux-gated module/reexport; removing that added block exactly restores the original. The returned config receives the same cognitive retrieval mode read from the original environment. No normal-build test constructor or public authority-bearing identity factory was introduced.

The shared input type and startup type have bounded sibling visibility and private fields. The startup passes the concrete OriginalLateWriterInputs value into the original async receive path. Identity is public only within the parent module as comparison data. Partial field moves and original Config/Root ownership are consistent with the reviewed source. This is static reasoning, not a Rust compilation result.

The two original late-writer tests remain an exact 5915-byte prefix. Six new methods cover readonly expected identity while the original writer lock remains held, refusal of old/Running generation, canonical path/layout mismatch, absent-selector argument preservation, duplicate/unknown selection rejection, and failed actual-owner attempt consumption without fallback. They do not prove a successful launched Root+daemon CLI, new Running state, cold restart or retained-A recovery.

All 492 original boundary blocks are byte-equal in the proposed registry, and every original required ID remains. Four actual new boundaries were added for prepare/consume of the owned input and CLI startup; three protected entries enforce the new actual path and original authority ordering. The existing public convenience method retains its empty external caller set; same-file delegation is protected by explicit function order. New helpers use exact nongeneric function locators. This direct text/inventory review is not a substitute for the original masked-Rust resolver or full closed-caller gate.

remaining_limits: The unchanged default hepta-authority-host CLI still emits its fresh two-right purpose. This new explicit consumer requires a legitimate host-composed original three-right writer handoff, such as the existing public Prepared-session sender path. No paired default Root recovery deployment is claimed.

The adapter requires a real Supervisor Starting admission and a dedicated live non-Root recipient. It does not retire an old peer, create a new Starting generation, rotate an issuer or adopt physical Root state.

No original retained-A capability can be serialized or recovered across actual predecessor exit by this delta. Same-Running task/profile replacement and the cross-incarnation ordinary learning protocol remain outside its authority.

Actual Primary/application/app-server readiness and optional Learning/Model capabilities remain mandatory under the unchanged launch. No default Ready, Outcome, B evaluator, independently completed C or cold-loop evidence was generated.

The original caller checker, original typed resolver, rustfmt, Cargo, six-crate tests, Root17 execution and CLI process tests were not run by this review. The new 6 methods and existing 17 Root parents require qualification on the final integrated immutable source.
